annotations.title: Planning authority profile: plans, HDT, appeals

description:
A planning authority at a glance: its local plans with stage, dates,
    period and housing requirement; the plan timetable; the Housing Delivery
    Test result and consequence and other published facts (five-year supply,
    affordable %, CIL) each with its source and date; Planning Inspectorate
    appeal outcomes over the last 12 months; and which land layers we hold for
    it. Pass `lpa_code` (GSS), or a `location`/`postcode` to use the authority
    there. A five-year-supply figure is the council's own claim; appeal
    decisions can find otherwise. England and Wales. Free.
